title.english: Dusk Beyond the End of the World

synonyms: ยามอัสดงกัลปาวสาน
description:
When growing tensions around AI spark civil unrest, Akira is caught in the crossfire when he protects his girlfriend from an assassin’s bullet. Hundreds of years later, he awakens from cryogenic sleep to an unfamiliar world. As he struggles to come to terms with his new reality, he bonds with an android called Yugure, who bears an uncanny resemblance to his girlfriend. Now, he must ask himself what love means in a world where technology has changed the very fabric of society.

(Source: HIDIVE)

Note: Includes Prologue.

node.description: An android in the future who pressures Akira into marriage. She looks exactly like Towasa. She has a wide range of weapons and high combat power that allows her to overwhelm even large numbers of opponents. She has a deep connection with Towasa, but keeps quiet about anything related to her, calling it "taboo."

She is the only daughter of the Oumaki family, who adopted Akira. She is a genius scientist developing cutting-edge AI technology, and has attracted attention from around the world. However, because she creates such revolutionary technology, she has been subjected to extreme criticism and interference with her research from some people. She has a crush on Akira, and has been worrying about him lately.

Akira and Yugure meet this girl during their journey. She is searching for a picture book that her parents once drew but that has been banned in the future world. Her dream is to become a picture book author like her parents.

A high school boy with excellent grades and good looks. After losing his parents at a young age, he was raised by his father's friend's family. He has a crush on his childhood friend and housemate, Towasa. He is seriously injured in an incident and falls unconscious. After being put into cold sleep, he wakes up in a future world.

She has the same face as Yugure and is one of the commanders of the OWEL special forces. She is an android specialized in search and support. She works alongside Yoiyami, who is relentlessly pursuing Yugure in an attempt to capture her, but she doesn't seem to be pursuing Yugure very seriously. She has a warm and gentle demeanor and is sensitive to smells.

An android with the same face as Yugure, she is one of the commanders of the OWEL special forces. She has an honest and inflexible personality. She specializes in attack and uses an extendable sword as her weapon. She is pursuing Yugure for a mission. However, it seems she has other reasons for pursuing Yugure besides the mission...

She is a potential heir to the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. She is competitive and loyal. She is fighting for the succession with her younger brother, Kalkram. She shows extreme disgust when Kalcrom occasionally uses the words "true love." She is desperately searching for a partner for "Elsie" in order to fulfill the conditions to become the next boss. She trusts her beloved horse, Kenshin.

A girl who discovers Akira waking up in the future world. She is curious and friendly. She lives in Hakodate Village. Her father is the village chief, Weir, and her mother is Taberina. She is not intimidated by Akira, who is worshipped as a god, and is interested in what happened to him and the past. Vogt, who lives with Weir and Taberina, is Idhi's Elpa (the name given to someone who is not her biological father in the Elsie system).

She is the proprietress of the hot spring resort, Kizunoyu. She and Haniyama are "Elsie's" partner, "Sierra." She values ​​the time she spends with Haniyama and the hot springs above all else. She hopes to run the inn together with Haniyama.

She is the head librarian of the library managed by OWEL in Sendai. She loves books, devotes herself to them, and is faithful to her job. She loves all the books in the library with all her heart. It seems that she has her own private space in the closed stacks room at the back of the library.
A historian with an adult aura. A former OWEL employee. He once saw Towasa's name in documents at OWEL. A feminist who doesn't wear an "Elsie" name.

A female administrator at OWEL. She is related to Ajisai as "Sierra," Elsie's partner. For certain reasons, she prioritizes work over Ajisai, which causes tension between them.
She has also not kept her promise to help out at the hot spring inn.

A slender woman who excels at sewing and painting. She is a "Sierra" of Vale and the mother of twins. Her voice is so quiet that it is difficult to hear even at close range. She is a good "Sierra" and a good mother who cares for others.
A large man who runs a wholesale store. He is a kind-hearted person. He travels from place to place for work and appears wherever Akira and his friends go.

An OWEL employee ordered to move to Omiya. He is large and has a loud voice. His family consists of Casta, a "Sierra," and her twin children, Louv and Caero. He shows more consideration for Casta than necessary, but...

He is a potential heir to the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. He has a cheesy personality. He is actually brother to Fides, his rival in the fight for the throne. As a condition for becoming the next boss of the Lontano family, he must "leave behind a successor," so he is searching for a partner. He believes that temporary love is meaningless, and is searching for "true love" for himself.

He is the general administrator of the North H4-27 district of OWEL. He manages Hakodate Village and the surrounding area. He instills unreasonable fear in the low-ranking residents. He is always on the lookout for opportunities to advance in his career. He is proud of his large physique and superhuman strength.

He is an administrator who oversees the people known as "Letogia," who have given up their human rights in society under OWEL's control for various reasons. He is a germaphobe and cannot forgive those who do not follow OWEL's laws. He is the type of person who will not hesitate to hurt others in order to achieve his goals. In the past, he aspired to be a rock singer. He is Canis's second cousin.

He is the boss of the Lontano family, a mafia that controls the town of Aomori. He is also the biological father of Kalkram and Fides. He is strict and brutal, and values ​​unity and trust above all else. He has many children, including Elsie, and pits them against each other to fight for the succession.
